[b]Dear Players![/b]

[i]I have great news! I have created a publisher page that you can subscribe to in order to stay updated with the latest news about my games. On this page, you will be able to learn about:[/i]
[b][list]
[*] New releases and upcoming games

[*] Exclusive discounts and special offers
[/list][/b]
[i]Don't miss out on any important news — subscribe now and stay connected with me![/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/dev/theNekoDev]Link[/url]

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]
